_comment: Defaults for the 'Price, Stock and Shipping Information' tab.
ORIGIN, AND WHY IT MATTERS: these were harvested from another seller's bot (Svarupam
Trecon / Party Fox) and had NEVER been compared with Flipkart's live form — WW-015. On
2026-08-03 Vansh pasted the real form and four keys turned out to match nothing at all.
Corrected below. Anything still wrong shows up as a field the fill step reports missing,
never as a wrong value silently typed in.
LABELS MUST MATCH THE FORM EXACTLY (case and spacing are normalised, nothing else):
• 'Fullfilment by' is spelt that way ON FLIPKART. It is their typo and we must copy it;
the correct spelling matches no row.
• 'Minimum Order Quantity (MinOQ)' carries the abbreviation in the label itself.
• THE PACKAGE DIMENSIONS ARE NOT HERE ANY MORE, and that is deliberate — WW-123.
Vansh photographed both tabs. Package Details on THIS tab is Length/Breadth/Height in
CM and Weight in KG, and the units are FIXED LABELS, not pickers — so 'Length (unit)'
and its two siblings addressed controls that do not exist and could never have filled.
Worse, 'Height' and 'Weight' also exist on the Additional Description tab, in INCHES,
and loadProduct() merges every defaults file into ONE flat map keyed by label. One
'Height' was therefore typed into both tabs: this file's 8 went in as 8 cm here and 8
INCHES there, and its 0.16 kg overwrote a parcel Vansh has measured at 0.250.
Package Details is now filled BY HAND from the Inventory panel, which computes it from
the kit (src/packaging.ts) and shows the four values ready to copy. The bot still fills
the inch Dimensions block, where no collision is possible.
PER-PRODUCT, DELIBERATELY NOT HERE: Seller SKU ID, MRP and Your selling price. They
belong in products/<ID>.json because they differ per listing, and PROMPT-product.md now
emits them as TODO_ placeholders so checkValues() blocks before the browser opens rather
than filling a listing with somebody else's price.
⚠️ 'Weight' IS AMBIGUOUS AND THIS IS THE ONE TO WATCH. loadProduct() merges every defaults
file into ONE flat map used on EVERY tab, so a label appearing on two tabs cannot be told
apart. products/ANP003.json already sets Weight = 0.25, which overrides the 0.16 here and
will be typed into whichever tab is open. WW-055 records a live listing carrying
'Net Weight = 10000 g' and says it costs real money at settlement, so this exact family of
field has already gone wrong once. The scan will settle whether the Additional Description
tab calls it 'Weight' or 'Net Weight'; until it does, read the weight before submitting.
STILL TO CONFIRM ON THE LIVE FORM:
• Luxury Cess — the form showed '-1 PERCENTAGE' where this file says '0'. Left at 0
because -1 looks like an empty-state placeholder, not a value. Check before trusting.
• HSN 95030020 is the toys/festive chapter — confirm with your CA for your SKUs.
• Package dims are for a small balloon pack; override per product.
Tax Code GST_5 was CONFIRMED off the live form on 2026-08-03 — it is no longer a guess.
Anything here is overridden by the product file's own 'values'.
